6.3 Class FMFeatureMap
A FMFeatureMap aggregates a number of FMFeatureMapElements in the role map-
ping.
Class
FMFeatureMap
Note
A FMFeatureMap associates FMFeatures with variation points in the AUTOSAR model. To do this, it
defines value sets for system constants and postbuild variant criterions that shall be chosen whenever a
certain combination of features (and system constants) is encountered.

AUTOSAR Feature Model Exchange Format
5.5
Valid Feature Selection
[TPS_FMDT_00030] Definition of Valid Feature Selection
Upstream requirements: RS_FMDT_00003, RS_FMDT_00005, RS_FMDT_00008
⌈Let S be a FMFeatureSelectionSet and F be the feature set of S. S is a valid
feature selection if all the following constraints are obeyed:
• [TPS_FMDT_00046] (Semantics of FMFeatureDecomposition)
• [TPS_FMDT_00045] (Semantics of FMFeatureRestriction)
• [TPS_FMDT_00044] (Semantics of FMFeatureRelation)
⌋
